theme: Two days to Croatia — the last open Sunday to clear the board.
greeting: Morning, Dan — an open Sunday in St. Pete with the girls, and the last clear one before you fly. The 15-minute review with Mike at nine is the natural place to knock the pre-trip board down toward zero.

needsAttention.title: Halloween: St Pete or Maine
needsAttention.detail: This was due yesterday and it's the real blocker — the Oct 18–Nov 1 St Pete house and car both cover Halloween, and that rotation books while you're on the boat. Settle it before you fly, not from Croatia.

needsAttention.title: The Sept 19 Cavtat night still isn't booked
needsAttention.detail: Charter ends noon Saturday the 19th at ACI Komolac; you need a Cavtat room plus a pre-booked transfer before the 7:30 AM Sunday flight. Connectivity's gone once you're aboard, so this has to close before Sept 8 — not on the 19th.

needsAttention.title: St Pete landing gap, Sept 20–22
needsAttention.detail: You land TPA Sunday the 20th but the kids aren't picked up until Tuesday the 22nd — two nights near St Pete are still open before the Orlando villa starts.

needsAttention.title: Get the Croatia bags confirmed in writing
needsAttention.detail: The issued ticket shows zero checked bags on Eurowings Discover; pull it up on the operating carrier's own site and buy the two duffels online now, before airport-counter rates Thursday.

needsAttention.title: Nail down Nautilus boarding + return transfer
needsAttention.detail: The instructor's contact is already in your inbox — confirm the Saturday Sept 12 boarding time and place and arrange the airport transfer for after you disembark the 19th, while you still have signal.

schedule.title: Sunday review with Mike
schedule.detail: 15 min on Meet — empty the board, owner and date on everything

flagged.title: Amex reported balance ticked up
flagged.detail: myFICO flagged a higher reported balance on the card — a heads-up worth a glance, not an action.

flagged.title: ICGN Toronto conference now open
flagged.detail: The governance network's November conference in Toronto is taking bookings — one for the board-search calendar once the trip's behind you.

inbox.noise: The rest is newsletters and promos — Breeze, West Marine, Mattress Firm, and your Italian and Japanese dailies.

resolved.title: UN PRI intro with Conor Kehoe — parked till you're back
resolved.detail: You replied Thursday that it's no rush and you're traveling; Kate is holding the diary open for your return, so nothing is owed until then.

recipe.title: Kabocha squash, yukon gold potatoes & cipolline
recipe.why: Early-September squash is just coming into its own — a warm, rooty tray-roast to ease the household toward autumn.

tasks.title: Book the refundable Sept 20–Oct 5 SUV as a backup
Buy EU plug adapters + a US power strip

acts.line: One 15-minute review with Mike at nine, then the morning is clear.
Nothing on the calendar — a rare open stretch two days before twelve away.
The girls are in the house in St. Pete; kabocha squash is tonight's from-scratch supper.
